context_and_flow.screen_type: Account registration screen in a mobile application.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: Persuade a guest user to create an account through social login or email authentication to secure their data.
ux_patterns: The illustration is a geometric, flat-style vector graphic centered at the top, reinforcing the security theme.
Primary call-to-action is a dark, high-contrast button.
The use of '30+ million learners' serves as social proof.
Layout is vertically centered with logical grouping of information from top to bottom.

interaction_elements: Primary call-to-action is a dark, high-contrast button.
visual_keywords: Modern, clean mobile UI with vector-based flat illustrations and high-contrast call-to-action buttons.
